title: Release Notes Pipeline & Partner Enablement for Version Phaseout
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Purpose: Build an automated release-notes pipeline plus partner enablement kit to support a staged phaseout of legacy Model API v1. This ticket coordinates cross-functional deliverables: canonical release notes generation, SDK deprecation warnings, partner-facing migration checklist, in-product upgrade nudges, and a lightweight partner training webinar. Goals: reduce manual comms overhead, ensure consistent messaging, and provide measurable migration uptake signals. Scope: - Author canonical release-note templates for engineers and PMs to populate (changelogs, breaking changes, migration steps). - Implement a pipeline that pulls changelog entries from PR labels and formats them into: public release notes, partner brief, and SDK changelog entries. - Ship an SDK deprecation warning mechanism (server-side feature flag + client-side lint messages). - Create partner enablement pack: one-pager, migration checklist, sample migration scripts, and a 45-minute training slide deck + recording. - Coordinate GTM timeline with Sales, Support, Docs, DevRel, and Legal for contractual messaging. Out of scope: billing or contract renegotiation (handled by Sales Ops), and deep model runtime changes (handled by ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Automated release-notes pipeline runs successfully from PR labels -> draft release notes in Google Docs via templates
SDKs emit clear deprecation warning logs (console and telemetry) when using v1 endpoints and link to migration docs
Partner enablement pack published to Drive and shared with top 10 partners with tracking links
In-product banner (Console) shows staged upgrade nudges for 100% of v1 tenants in the experiment cohort
GTM calendar confirmed with Sales, Support, Docs, and DevRel and playbook published to Confluence
